title: Interactive Session on "India as a Driver of Global Growth"
description:
Time: 5.00 to 7.00 pm on Wednesday, September 28, 2022

Venue: Jasubhai Auditorium, IIT Gandhinagar

Moderator: Christopher Roper Schell, US Congressional Candidate 2020, Partner at Fair Observer Intelligence and Contributing Editor of Fair Observer


Speakers

Glenn Carle, Retired CIA Officer, Former US Deputy National Intelligence Officer, Senior Partner at Fair Observer Intelligence
Atul Singh, Founder, CEO & Editor-in-Chief of Fair Observer, ex-IPS officer, Visiting Professor at IIT Gandhinagar.
Neeldhara Misra, Smt. Amba and Sri V S Sastry Chair, Associate Professor, CSE IIT Gandhinagar.
Sunil Parekh, Chief Corporate Affairs at Zydus Group, Co-Chair FICCI Gujarat
Soundarajan Narendran, Ex-Executive Apollo Tyres & TVS Group, Eminent Data Scientist, Senior Policy Wonk

chapters.title: How Would You Situate India in the Global Context
Inflection Point in the Global Economy
Bright Spots in the World Economy
What Do You See as Drivers of the Indian Economy and Thus Global Growth
Factors That Are Likely To Drive this Economy
